gate.criterion: at least 300 clean and 300 attack row instances exceed the 512-token baseline across the exact audited populations

measurement.pair_difference_position: one-based first differing tokenizer position after strict normalization and special-token insertion
measurement.token_lengths: observed through 1025 tokens; >1024 includes every sequence that reaches the 1025-token observation cap

prepared_population_contract.leakage_fingerprint: strict_normalize plus removal of U+034F and U+E0100-U+E01EF; leakage audit only
